description:
A bandcamp only exclusive, marking the beginning of this new chapter.
A bold, groove-driven track, it blends 70s blaxploitation funk with hip-hop sensibilities, built around marching drums and a hypnotic bassline from bassist Jamien. 
Inspired by artists like Ali Shaheed Muhammad and Kaytranada, the track is a celebration of self-belief and community. Its title lifted from a friend’s remark: “You and your band are the truth.”

New album coming soon.
